use.flag: Pull in sys-apps/ai-jail and explain how to run dev-util/claude-agent-acp-plus inside it, as a second agent in Zeo with a writable project, network limited to anthropic.com and a separate Claude config directory

Install the claude-agent-acp-plus ACP agent and apply source patches that force-enable the acp-beta feature flag plus agent panel UI improvements: multiline elicitation fields, collapsible markdown option previews, a manual-mode badge, clickable file mentions in replayed messages, and adoption of the agent's config-option response; also makes a thread menu choice (permission mode, model, thinking effort, agent config option) apply to that thread only, with Shift to make it the default for new threads
Install the claude-agent-acp-tui ACP bridge to run the Claude Code TUI in the agent panel
Native Claude Code CLI editor integration (unofficial reverse-engineered IDE protocol, WebSocket MCP server) via a source patch

Apply a source patch that adds the devtools bridge: a unix socket under $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR that the zeo-devtools Vite plugin uses to put an element clicked in the dev page into the agent composer (needs claude-agent-acp-plus)
Build the GPUI UI inspector, which shows the element tree, layout and styles of the interface at run time
Use mimalloc as the global memory allocator for improved performance
Enable Neovim integration for full vim compatibility via RPC
Enable screen capture support for collaboration sessions
Enable Tracy profiler integration for performance analysis

pkgmetadata.longdescription:
Zeo is the Zed editor carrying the bentoo patch series - the Claude agent integrations and the agent-panel changes built on them - with a distinct identity of its own: name, icon, release channel, application binary, URL scheme and state directories. It is built from a snapshot of Zed's main branch named by EGIT_COMMIT and versions itself; app-editors/zed builds upstream's releases unpatched.
Exactly one of app-editors/zed, zed-bin, zeo and zeo-bin is installed at a time. app-editors/zeo-bin is this package prebuilt for x86-64-v3.
The collab, extensions-cli and remote-server flags app-editors/zed offers are absent here: each installs a binary under a Zed name.
